Here is a pair of galaxies in the constellation Leo. M66 is on the left and M65 on the right.
Messier 65, discovered in 1780 by the French astronomer Charles Messier, is located 22 light-years away while Messier 66, also discovered in 1780, is located 36 light-years away.
